claims.method: Intersect coast-masked approximate OSW state polygons and NASA's 70 published equirectangular crop rectangles in the same display projection, allowing 360-degree horizontal wraps. Exclude contacts covering at most 0.001% of a state's display area. Rank each state's regional crops by display overlap at the highest zoom with any overlap. The overview is the level-1 crop with greatest display overlap, or level 0 if unavailable.

geometries.method: Approximate editorial locator points place a name in a recognizable region on the OSW equirectangular map. Points are neither observed cores nor endpoints or length measurements. Multi-basin family names have one point per basin and must be split into separate records before quantitative comparison.

named_current_source_observations.spatial_basis: OSW projects the three paper-reported instrument positions into the approximate coast-masked state polygons. All three positions fall in CHIN. These are mooring locations, not the Kuroshio axis or an interpolated cross-stream boundary.
named_current_source_observations.state_boundary_limit: The CHIN link is a lookup of three instrument points against approximate display geography; it is not whole-current containment, intersection, or a measured state boundary. The paper places the current core west of the array.
named_current_source_observations.time_detail: The paper reports January 2018 to May 2020, without exact deployment and recovery days here. This is the reported study window, not a claim of continuous valid coverage at every depth or station.
